kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تلعثمت (form IIq)
# تَلَعْثَمْتُ (talaʕṯamtu) /ta.laʕ.θam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# تَلَعْثَمْتَ (talaʕṯamta) /ta.laʕ.θam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# تَلَعْثَمْتِ (talaʕṯamti) /ta.laʕ.θam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# تَلَعْثَمَتْ (talaʕṯamat) /ta.laʕ.θa.mat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
